title: Derived Mayer–Vietoris triangle for a two-open cover
statement: Let W be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U and V be quasi-compact open subschemes with W = U union V, and write j_U:U \to W, j_V:V \to W, and j_{UV}:U intersect V \to W for the open immersions. For every E in D_{QCoh}(O_W) [def-pc-derived-category], there is a distinguished triangle E \to R(j_U)_* E|_U direct-sum R(j_V)_* E|_V \to R(j_{UV})_* E|_{U intersect V} \to E[1] in D_{QCoh}(O_W) [def-pc-derived-direct-image], with the quasi-coherence of the derived direct-image terms supplied by [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh]; the first map is the pair of restriction adjunction maps and the second map is the difference of the two restriction maps.

source.place: Lemma cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-j-star, Tag 08BV, distinguished Mayer–Vietoris triangle for a ringed space covered by two open subspaces; specialized here to a qcqs scheme and quasi-coherent derived categories

proof.text: Represent E by K=Q.objPreimage E, choose the functorial K-injective resolution I with injective components, and obtain e:QI isomorphic to E from Q of its natural quasi-isomorphism [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Construct the restriction/direct-image adjunctions by deriving the underived restriction adjunction after the canonical over-site equivalence [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps].
Apply [lem-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-presentation] to obtain a short exact sequence I -> B -> C and comparison isomorphisms e_B,e_C with exactly the specified first two arrows.

Use the actual connecting morphism of [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle], and set delta=e_C inverse followed by triangleOfSESdelta followed by the shift of e. Triangle.isoMk with e,e_B,e_C and the two arrow comparison identities gives an isomorphism to the distinguished short-exact-sequence triangle. The third square is the cancellation e_C hom followed by e_C inverse = identity. Transport distinguishedness along this isomorphism.

Exact restriction commutes with homology: choose Q.objPreimage, compose mapDerivedCategoryFactors, homologyFunctorFactors and mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso, and transport along the representative isomorphism. Restrict each quasi-coherent cohomology sheaf and transport its quasi-coherent presentations across the over-site equivalence, using Mathlib isQuasicoherent_over and isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint. This proves quasi-coherence of the restricted derived object. Compact opens define compact open subschemes, so their inclusions are quasi-compact into the quasi-separated target and are quasi-separated open immersions. The intersection is compact by QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact. Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh] three times.

lean.statement: theorem schemeDerived_mayerVietoris_triangle (X : Scheme.{u₁}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings (U ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E) : ∃ (adjU : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι) (adjV : (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι) (adjUV : (schemeOpenRestriction X (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage (U ⊓ V).ι) (δ : (schemeDerivedDirectImage (U ⊓ V).ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ⟶ E⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk (biprod.lift (adjU.unit.app E) (adjV.unit.app E)) (biprod.desc (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_left) adjU adjUV E) (-(schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_right) adjV adjUV E))) δ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory X) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty X ((schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty X ((schemeDerivedDirectImage V.ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty X ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (U ⊓ V).ι).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
